chronology: max(received_mono_ns, sequence) across actual read/notification/last observation; pending/rejected newer item vetoes older success; no older-event fallback
durability: real unchanged CreditBudget.observe -> existing ledger atomic_json fsync; unchanged accounting saves limits+matching credit via Campaign.save/atomic_json; read original actual disk pair and validate before final receipt save; no receipt from request/heartbeat/mtime
finite_new_test_obligations: actual no-notification read publishes only after original ledger+matching state persistence
failed ledger/state/receipt persistence and actual holds do not grant success
read response before newer notification and reverse ordering; valid newest wins; newer hold/unknown/spend vetoes
freshness: both 0 <= now - actual receive <25s; same boot/owner required
hold_semantics: original accounting and notification-only transport fallback byte/AST retained; stopped/nonrunning/nonactive owner never grants new acceptance
late_read: retain genuine older read conservative accounting; restore and re-observe genuine newer limits through SAME ledger without refund/new freshness; no synthetic notification and no cleared hold
native_scope: none; no native/controller transition or new publication authority from this source
new_instance: new observation fields removed only from new Campaign in-memory state; original budget/goal/state ownership unchanged
owner_required_source: consumer must independently validate current boot/repo/guardian run/Root thread/goal and exact worker/server pid births, same original credit guard id/budget/path; never take expected owner from the receipt itself
pending_proofs: normal reviewed sameRoot controller load/stop/start and actual new invocation owner binding
